translation_loss.what_was_lost: The Urdu-derived poetic word 'tanha' (lonely/solitary) carries a specific aesthetic of Urdu ghazal poetry which is flattened into the standard English 'lonely'.
The Urdu-derived word 'armanon' (yearnings/desires/aspirations) carries a deep, romantic, and melancholic weight in Hindustani poetry that is simplified to 'desires' in English.

annotation.theme: The silent, unexpressed longing of a lover who finds solace only in dreams and quiet devotion.

original_poem:
एक आशिक

एक आशिक
जो अपने दिल की बात
कभी न कह सका।

वो तन्हा रातों में
अपनी चाहत को
सितारों में खोजता है।

चाँद की चाँदनी में
अपने अरमानों को
कभी समझा न सका।

वो प्रेम में डूबा
हर धड़कन में
सिर्फ तेरा नाम लेता है।

सपनों की दुनिया में
तेरे साथ बिताए पल
हर लम्हा जीता है।
translated_poem:
A Lover

A lover
Who could never express
The words of his heart.

In lonely nights,
He seeks his love
Among the stars.

In the moonlight,
He could never convey
His desires.

Deep in love,
In every heartbeat,
He only utters your name.

In the world of dreams,
He lives every moment
Spent with you.
